ops.body: Field data from the yasyf-home cookiesync cutover (2026-07-26) strengthening this task: .app-class helpers are NOT staged — canonicalHelperProgram does LookPath+EvalSymlinks and installs the resolved path with no staging step (daemon/service.go:105-118), so cookiesync's converged plist bakes /opt/homebrew/Caskroom/cookiesync/0.27.3/CookieSync.app/Contents/MacOS/cookiesync. Two consequences observed the same day: (1) 'brew upgrade --cask' purges the running version's dir, hard-killing the resident helper before any converge runs (PID 1800 died exactly this way); (2) after the next upgrade the installed plist will dangle at the purged 0.27.3 path until a manual re-install. daemonkit-staged programs (digest-keyed StableProgramFrom, as reposync's plain-exe helper now uses) make both impossible — the .app class needs the equivalent, i.e. this task. Also: cell test keyless × daemonkit-caller × .app × SSH real-HOME PASSED (bootstrap is not the problem); Touch-ID/Keychain consent remains UNVERIFIED over SSH — user physical session needed (helper log showed zero Keychain/authorization errors during the 15-min window, weak positive signal only).
